plugins.name: reporting-derived-metrics

plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: normalizing-text-for-measurement
plugins.description: Strip, parse, and segment a document before something else measures it - close tokens that emit no separator and fuse two blocks into one word, character-based metrics inflated by leftover syntax while word-based metrics break on boundaries the strip never inserted, sibling consumers that skip the normalizer, parser presets whose rule set reclassifies a construct, sections keyed by a non-unique heading that collapse and double-count into an ancestor, deliberate lossiness mistaken for a bug, and regression tests that assert markdown-equals-plain-equivalent instead of a float from an unpinned library
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: reproducing-ci-locally
plugins.description: Make the local check agree with the runner - deriving the command, paths, markers and env from the workflow file rather than the Makefile, unblocking gate steps that short-circuit and hide the next failure, pinning the linter version CI resolves, building the interpreter and extras the runner builds, and confirming a run is green instead of explaining a red job away
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: shipping-build-artifacts
plugins.description: Make the build step a real gate on what you distribute - scripts that fail instead of warning on a missing input, size checks bounded on both sides, file lists checked against the entrypoints they must cover, committed bundles that can't go stale, portable release shell, and artifact verification that runs before the upload
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: resumable-sync-jobs
plugins.description: Write batch and sync jobs that fail honestly - exit codes that report partial failure, checkpoints that are safe to resume, per-item tolerance vs fatal abort, unknown-vs-zero in aggregated output, bounded retries, honest dry-runs, and compensating reserved quota
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: verifying-external-behavior
plugins.description: Confirm what a third-party library, remote API, build backend, or scraped document actually does before depending on it - throwaway probes, permissive clients that forward wrong arguments, per-endpoint docs that don't generalize, fakes that encode your assumption, and dry-runs that skip the failing step
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: shipping-across-surfaces
plugins.description: Land a change everywhere the same fact is stated - the full surface inventory from landing copy to untyped frontend consumers of typed responses, generating a surface instead of restating it, drift tests against the live registry, never hand-maintaining a copy of a surface another codebase owns, paired PRs for format changes, and keeping overloaded product words apart
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: wiring-application-config
plugins.description: Load, merge and validate layered application configuration so a mis-wired or misspelled key fails loudly instead of reverting to the default - sections the code reads that exist nowhere, sections nothing reads, unvalidated recursive merges, bool passing as int, defaults aliased by a shallow merge, falsy-but-valid values killed by or/||, partial write-backs stickier than a missing file, and bootstrap ordering that swallows the loader's own warnings
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: merging-concurrent-branches
plugins.description: Resolve conflicts when several branches are open against one repo at once - the hotspot files every change touches, additive registries unioned instead of chosen, version counters recomputed from the integration branch, generated artifacts rebuilt rather than merged, deterministic serialization so diffs stay reviewable, shared identifiers appended and never renumbered, and re-running the real gate because a clean auto-merge is not a passing test
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: writing-defect-reports
plugins.description: Establish a finding before you publish it and correct it after - headlines that overstate what reproduces at the layer a user sees, reporting code no entry point reaches, guards that only match the fixture written beside them, caveats the project's own records already answered, prior notes re-verified against the tree rather than against the note, the narrowest injection point that reproduces a failure, probe output a harness swallows, red gates described as pre-existing, and withdrawing a published claim in the thread where it was published
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: guarding-destructive-operations
plugins.description: Put real preconditions on operations that delete, overwrite, or rewrite history, and on code that turns a caller-supplied name into a path - refusing instead of warning, guards placed ahead of the first mutation, structural ownership checks rather than string prefixes, name validation plus resolved-path containment as two independent checks, the deliberate dry-run gap, and mutation-testing each half separately
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: python-llm-features
plugins.description: Build application features on top of an LLM API - prompt surfaces that drift, filtered evaluator sets that cannot silently become clean passes, model config wiring, live-model tests kept out of CI, stochastic accuracy evaluation, and truthful presentation of model output
plugins.author: Will McGinnis

plugins.name: deferring-heavy-dependencies
